verdict:
WATCH, FLAT, no order - but the enum matters: this is not a KILL, because every number the benches checked verified CHEAPER than the brief claimed and the kill that survives is a control-and-timing kill, which the response taxonomy maps to SIZE and TRANCHE, not to dismissal.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY TRUE. 135,711,070 shares at 2026-07-31 (dei XBRL, both benches), cash $583.1M plus $11.2M short-term deposits, zero borrowings, $22.6M of operating leases - market cap ~$1.12B, EV ~$541M, ~0.40x EV/sales on ~$1.35B of annualised revenue. Half the market cap is cash and the balance sheet has no debt. Against that: Q2 adjusted EBITDA $5.5M vs $9.7M, a Q3 guide of $0.0-5.0M (a guided-zero floor), operating cash flow -$6.3M vs +$5.7M, and Japan - 49% of revenue at the group's highest ARPPU - printing MPU -9.5% with the paying ratio at 9.4% against a 10.4% consensus.

THE KILL THAT SURVIVES IS ABOUT WHO CONTROLS THE CASH. Within days of the print, and 5.5% off the 52-week low, WEBTOON agreed to buy up to 60% of RI Games Holdings for KRW 150bn (~$100M, unit flag closed at the primary - the '$150M' mirrors were a naive 1000:1 conversion) from Kevin Tail Han, founder of RI Games AND of Redice Studio, the studio behind Solo Leveling, the flagship IP the thesis rests on, inside a company NAVER controls with 59.67%, with no buyback and further milestone commitments. A net-cash floor that minorities do not control is optionality for the controller, not a floor. That is a governance/business-risk finding: it caps SIZE, it does not by itself refute a 0.40x EV/sales platform.

WHERE OUR OWN BENCHES ERRED. First, the class assignment ('damage arriving, not structural') rests on evidence that does not exist: all five app_review_velocity runs (LINE Manga, Piccoma, Naver Webtoon KR, Kakao Webtoon, ebookjapan) returned UNRESOLVED. Both benches said so honestly and then both graded the class anyway. An absence of the only independent engagement read is a DATA gap, and per the taxonomy a data gap that would flip the class is a reason to hold the verdict open on a dated check, which is exactly what a WATCH is. Second, neither bench did the divergence work: the only street number anywhere in this record is the Japan paying-ratio consensus (10.4% vs 9.4% actual). Nobody stated what the street models for Q3 revenue or EBITDA against what we model, so the file cannot yet say whether we disagree with the street or merely with the brief. Third, red graded the SPA/SHA tail terms CONFIRMED from press coverage of documents that are unreadable image scans; blue caught it, and the correct posture is that the put/call obligations to 2030 are UNVERIFIED until a human reads the scans.

THE MOAT-REFUTATION CHECK (2026-08-18 rule). Japan's weakness is NOT capacity expansion or new entrants absorbing a growing market: ARPPU is up +2.9% cc while paying users fall, i.e. users are leaving at held prices. That is genuine demand damage, and blue's precision on this (Japan's break is attrition, not the price lever snapping) is the correct mechanism - it also means the Korea-becomes-Japan analogy is weaker than red claimed, since Korea's growth is price-led (ARPPU +14.8% > MPU +10.4%) against a market that is still paying.

SIZE IS NOT A DISQUALIFIER (2026-08-18 rule, applied). At ~628k shares/day and ~$8.29, 1% of ADV is ~$52k; a 1% position in a ~$1.03M book is ~$10.3k, i.e. well under a single day's participation. Nothing about this name is un-ownable on liquidity - the thin float (~15-18M shares) cuts the other way: it is squeeze fuel on any positive resolution.

ENTRY LOGIC. No entry today: guided-zero EBITDA quarter, ~60 trading days to an UNCONFIRMED catalyst, the desk's earnings-dislocation template is 0-for-7 (the headline IS the news), and the cash floor is being spent by a controller whose information we are adversely selected against. But the reopen is asymmetric and cheap to instrument, which is why this stays on the sheet.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED - blue re-pulled every load-bearing primary (dei share series, 10-Q R2 balance sheet, EX-99.1, DEF 14A, the advisory agreement) and sustained the three legs the kill actually stands on, while overturning finding 8 (the 'irreconcilable' short-interest data reconciles once you price the float correctly: NAVER 59.67% + LY Corp + Disney ~2% lock up ~85% of shares, so 2.75M short is ~2% of shares out but ~15-18% of float, and 2.75M/628k ADV is the quoted 4.4 days) and reducing findings 4 and 7. Blue's own best work is the downgrade it filed against red's favour: the RI Games SPA/SHA exhibits are IMAGE SCANS (39+43 JPGs), so the put/call and milestone tail red graded CONFIRMED is in fact UNVERIFIED at the primary. AUDIT NOTE per BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: blue's float/short overturn rests on Nasdaq's short-interest page plus proxy ownership arithmetic, not on a primary short-interest filing - it is directionally sound but I grade it PLAUSIBLE, not CONFIRMED, and no part of this verdict rests on it. Blue read most primaries through r.jina.ai; because red read the same documents through a direct EDGAR proxy and the two agree digit-for-digit on share count, cash and the EX-99.1 figures, the truncation risk did not bite here - and critically, NO absence claim in this record is sourced to a truncated read.
reopen_gates: DATA (primary, un-dated but cheap - run by 2026-09-30): app_review_velocity resolving for LINE Manga vs Piccoma vs ebookjapan with recent-cohort-vs-lifetime rating deltas. If LINE Manga velocity is stable while Piccoma decays, the Japan break is category-wide and bounded -> reopen a long court. If LINE Manga decays fastest, the structural read is right -> move to AVOID. This is the single decisive unmeasured variable and both benches flagged it; the runner must treat five UNRESOLVED returns as an infra failure to fix, not a negative result.

DATA (Q3 print, ~2026-11-16, yfinance-derived UNCONFIRMED): Japan MPU >= 2.1M or paying ratio >= 9.4% (stabilisation, not recovery) AND Korea revenue >= +15% cc AND Q4 adjusted EBITDA guided above zero. All three -> reopen at whatever price prints. Japan MPU < 2.0M with the paying ratio through 9% -> AVOID, the structural read wins.

EVENT: any buyback authorisation, tender, NAVER accumulation or take-private tell, or a non-index 13G/13D accumulation. This is the only mechanism that converts the cash pile from controller optionality into a minority floor, and on a ~15-18% short float it is the highest-convexity single event in the file.

DATA (owed before any future bench touches the deal tail): a human-visual read of the RI Games SPA and SHA image-scan exhibits (rigamesholding-spa_execu.htm / -sha_execu.htm) to bound the put/call and the KRW 50bn of further commitments. Chart-only-disclosure doctrine: grep misses pixels. Until then the 2030 tail is UNVERIFIED and no bench may grade it CONFIRMED.

DIVERGENCE (owed before any bid, per DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE): extract the street's Q3/FY26 revenue and adjusted-EBITDA consensus and state our number beside it with the mechanism. The paying-ratio consensus (10.4%) proves a street number exists for this name; a verdict that cannot state it has not done the work.

PRICE (conditioned, per the beta-carrier rule): WBTN's tape is idiosyncratic post-print, not carrier-dominated, so a valuation gate is admissible - but it must be conditioned on the floor still existing. Review-only alert at EV <= ~0.25x sales (roughly $6.30-6.50 at the current share count and cash), ACTIONABLE only if the last reported cash balance is >= $500M with no new controller-directed deployment. A fill driven by further cash deployment is the thesis getting worse, not cheaper.
process_findings: HELD STATUS: NOT HELD - no position, no order, and no ledger row exists for WBTN. This draft creates one (WATCH, court_gates).

DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE (2026-08-17): no coverage-based kill was attempted here, so nothing needed re-basing - but the file also never extracted the street's load-bearing number. The paying-ratio consensus (10.4%) shows the street publishes numbers on this name; extracting Q3 revenue/EBITDA consensus is now a pre-bid gate.

BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: blue's one overturn (short interest reconciles on float structure) is secondary-sourced (Nasdaq page + proxy ownership arithmetic) and is graded PLAUSIBLE, not CONFIRMED. No verdict weight rests on it. Blue's reductions of red findings 4 and 7 are both audits of red's inference rather than replacements of a primary figure, so the re-fetch rule is satisfied without a new pull.

FETCH DISCIPLINE: blue routed most primaries through r.jina.ai. Red used a direct EDGAR proxy on the same documents and the two agree on every load-bearing figure (135,711,070 shares; cash $583.145M; EX-99.1 EBITDA and guide), so no truncation-driven absence claim exists in this record. Future benches on this name should use desk/sec_fetch.py directly.

EVIDENCE GAP IS THE VERDICT'S BINDING CONSTRAINT: five app_review_velocity runs UNRESOLVED. Per infra-masquerading-as-negative doctrine this is a runner defect to fix, not a finding; the class assignment (arriving vs structural) is unmeasured in both directions and that, not valuation, is why the enum is WATCH.

PRINT CLOCK: next print ~2026-11-16 (UNCONFIRMED), roughly 62 trading days from 2026-08-17/18. No print-race discipline triggered; this is a post-print dislocation (Q2 landed 2026-08-10, two days before the sweep fired).
TAX: no distribution and no buyback - nothing load-bearing to after-tax carry. All return here is capital gain; a starter opened now would carry a short-term clock into 2027.

PROCESS: both benches' detector lists drifted from the dispatched atlas (red answered names blue's pack did not carry and vice versa). Same roster-drift family logged on FIG and INTR - the output validator should diff the consulted list against the dispatched atlas mechanically.

kg_candidates.name: controlled_company_supplier_buyout_at_low
kg_candidates.source: red bench (WBTN); blue sustained and strengthened from the primary EX-99.3 and DEF 14A
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - the batch's cleanest governance mechanism and the only leg of this court that is both CONFIRMED at the primary and decision-changing. It converts a screenable 'net cash = floor' input into a controller-optionality input.
kg_candidates.one_line: A majority-controlled issuer deploys minority cash to buy a key content/input supplier owned by an ecosystem insider at the equity trough, converting the net-cash floor into controller optionality with multi-year contingent obligations.
kg_candidates.fires_on: 10-Q/8-K exhibit SPA+SHA where the counterparty principal is a disclosed content partner or supplier, the issuer is a controlled company (>50% single holder per the proxy), the deal signs within ~30 days of a >50% drawdown low, and put/call or milestone commitments extend multi-year
kg_candidates.evidence_here: WBTN: RI Games SPA/SHA filed with the 2026-08-10 10-Q; seller Kevin Tail Han, founder of RI Games and of Redice Studio (Solo Leveling); NAVER 59.67% per the DEF 14A; ~$100M funded from cash on hand, signed 2026-08-06 with the stock 5.5% off its 52-week low; no buyback authorised.

kg_candidates.name: image_scan_exhibit_terms_unverifiable
kg_candidates.source: blue bench (WBTN); adjudicator promotes it - blue filed it as an aside and it is a reusable evidence-grade rule
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - sibling of the chart-only-disclosure doctrine on the contract plane. It caught a bench grading press-reported deal terms as CONFIRMED against a primary that is machine-unreadable.
kg_candidates.one_line: Material agreement exhibits filed as image scans (JPG/TIFF page images rather than text) are unverifiable by text tooling - any term quoted from them is secondary-sourced until a human or OCR pass reads the pages.
kg_candidates.fires_on: an exhibit index lists a material agreement whose file is an image container or whose text extraction returns near-zero characters per page, AND a bench cites specific terms (put/call, milestones, earn-outs, covenants) from that agreement
kg_candidates.evidence_here: WBTN 10-Q exhibits rigamesholding-spa_execu.htm and -sha_execu.htm are 39 and 43 page images; red graded the put/call-to-2030 and milestone commitments CONFIRMED while both figures trace only to GamesBeat/Bloomberg coverage.

packs_to_arm.date_confidence: yfinance-derived, UNCONFIRMED - no company PR names it and ir.webtoon.com timed out on both benches; Q2 printed 2026-08-10 (CONFIRMED via the EDGAR 8-K/10-Q accessions), so the cadence supports mid-November. Re-key on the company PR. Interim resolvables that can settle branches early: app_review_velocity, any buyback authorisation, any 13G/13D.
packs_to_arm.adjudication: Read in this order: (1) Japan MPU and paying ratio against 2.1M / 9.4% - the class-deciding pair; (2) Japan revenue cc against -6.7%, and check whether the decline is ARPPU-led (price break, worse) or MPU-led at held prices (attrition, already in the record); (3) Korea revenue cc against +20% and its MPU/ARPPU split - a Korea decline that is price-led is the Japan playbook arriving; (4) Q4 adjusted-EBITDA guide against the $0.0-5.0M floor; (5) cash balance and any further RI Games tranche or new controller-directed deployment - the floor question; (6) any segment profit disclosure, which is the one datum that would make the Korea stub computable and is currently withheld.

branches.JAPAN MPU >= 2.1M AND PAYING RATIO STABL: damage bounded; reopen a long court at the printed price with size capped for controller risk - the 0.40x EV/sales stub with a 15-18% short float is the asymmetric case.
branches.JAPAN MPU 2.0-2.1M, EBITDA GUIDE STILL ~: unresolved again; hold WATCH, re-arm for Q4, and treat the app-review read as the tiebreaker rather than waiting another quarter.
branches.JAPAN MPU < 2.0M OR PAYING RATIO < 9%: structural read confirmed at the profit engine; move to AVOID and stop paying attention to the multiple - cheapness on a breaking paying-user base is not cheapness.
branches.FURTHER CASH DEPLOYED TO CONTROLLER-ADJA: floor thesis dead regardless of operating branch; AVOID and log the mechanism against the KG candidate.
branches.BUYBACK AUTHORISED OR NAVER ACCUMULATION: the floor becomes a minority floor; reopen immediately on mechanics, independent of the operating branch.
